ribbonHome.label: Wire
ribbonHome.tooltip: Wire: plain paper and ink edges, no mesh colours

ribbonHome.label: Colour Fill
ribbonHome.tooltip: Colour fill: wash the mesh colours onto the paper (colourless meshes stay paper)

ribbonHome.label: Colour Wire
ribbonHome.tooltip: Colour wire: the ink takes the mesh colour (colourless meshes keep the sketch ink)

ribbonHome.label: Selection Tint
ribbonHome.tooltip: Show the selection as a colour tint only

ribbonHome.label: Selection Outline
ribbonHome.tooltip: Show the selection as an outline only (items keep their true colours)

ribbonHome.label: Selection Both
ribbonHome.tooltip: Show the selection as both a colour tint and an outline
